artefacts.description: Full scene with 280 seed platelets, five shape keys, PhylloArm vertex colour.
Draco-6 WebP GLB; morph targets for all five divergence-angle keys; +Y-up.
8-second viewport animation: overhead → orbit → morph demo → pull-back.
Full screen recording of the tutorial session (OBS capture).

studio_internal.note: Apollonian gasket — another disc-packing problem; compare recursive inversive geometry vs iterative Vogel model.
Icosahedral quasicrystal — 6D cut-and-project also uses irrational numbers to avoid periodicity; Fibonacci parastichies are the 2D analogue.
Hypotrochoid / spirograph — also uses GCD to determine closed-curve periodicity vs open spirals; compare with the role of rational/irrational α.
Holoflow Codex entry explaining phyllotaxis in the context of light-painting and structured patterning.
